description: This file defines a generic adapter class for wrapping an IDuplexPipe with a Stream interface, enabling easier stream-based handling of duplex pipes by creating input and output pipe readers/writers around a stream created from the pipe.

classes.name: DuplexPipeStreamAdapter<TStream>
classes.description: A generic internal class that adapts an IDuplexPipe to a Stream-based interface, wrapping input/output pipe readers and writers around a Stream instance created from the pipe.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the adapter by completing the input and output pipes after ensuring thread-safe disposal.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes of the adapter by completing the input and output pipes within a lock.
